title: Tinywave cohort rollout grid and briefing notes (2028-02) - draft
content:
Context:

This is the working rollup for the Tinywave cohort rollout (internal codename: tinywave). Purpose: staged rollout of the new routing heuristics + KV cache change that reduces tail latency for short-chat sessions while enabling a new canary-backoff behavior. Target cohort: 3% -> 10% -> 30% -> 100% over a seven-day window.

High-level goals:
- Validate latency improvements for p95/p99 on small-session traffic (<= 120 tokens).
- Ensure no regression in cost-per-token beyond 3%.
- Verify graceful fallback to previous routing if model-variant capacity saturates.

Quick links / refs:
- PR (runtime): https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4921
- Eval deck (metrics): Confluence link above
- Telemetry filters: prod.tinywave.* (see observability runbook)

Rolling calendar (compact) -- tentative slots (PDT):
- Day -3 (2028-02-05) : Dry run in staging: full smoke + traffic replay (team: SRE + serving-runtime).
- Day -1 (2028-02-07) : Canary config baked into staging (rollover hook), stakeholder sync at 11:00.
- Day 0 (2028-02-08) : Cohort 3% (06:00 rollout window). Monitor for 4 hours with fast rollback flag live.
- Day 1 (2028-02-09) : Assessment window, decision at 12:00 to expand -> 10% if all green.
- Day 3 (2028-02-11) : Expand to 30% at 09:00 if no alerts and p99 improved.
- Day 6 (2028-02-14) : Full tilt 100% at 04:00 pre-weekday low traffic. Post-mortem start at 12:00.

Operator checklist (pre-roll):
- [ ] Confirm model artifacts pinned in catalog (model id + quantization tag). PR linked above.
- [ ] Capacity reservation verified for cohort (Dedicated pools updated) — contact infra if burst needed.
- [ ] Canary-backoff policy present in routing policy config; confirm circuit-breaker thresholds.
- [ ] Smoke test matrix: generation, streaming, KV-cache hit rate, prefix-cache warmup checklist.
- [ ] Observability hooks are active: tracing sampling = increased for tinywave.* flows.
- [ ] Ops playbook checklist distributed to on-call rotation (including phone numbers).

Nightwatch / immediate-watch checklist (first 4 hours after each expansion):
- p50/p90/p95/p99 latency dashboards (filter: tinywave cohort). Thresholds:
  - p95 <= baseline - 10ms OR no more than +5% of baseline cost.
  - p99 must not increase by > 12% (if it does -> immediate rollback).
- Error budget burn rate: >5% in 30m window -> investigate, consider rollback.
- CPU/GPU saturation on serving hosts: any host > 85% for 5m -> alert SRE.
- Request routing errors / 5xxs increase by more than 0.5% absolute -> roll back.

Rollback criteria (fast path):
- Any sustained p99 increase beyond threshold for >10m following expansion.
- Spike in user-visible errors (5xxs) > 0.5% absolute.
- Telemetry shows KV-cache hit rate dropping > 15% from baseline for short sessions.
- Any cascading timeout in downstream infra (embed/redis/kv-store).

Communication cadence (who to ping):
- Critical Slack channel: #release-tinywave (pinned messages + canned rollback commands).
- Pager rotation: SRE primary (Marcus Lee), Serving-runtime on-call (Priya), Product liaison (Ethan).
- Exec updates: 1-line status at +4h and +24h (send to #product-ops and #gtm).

Smoke test scripts (short checklist for run):
- Run script: scripts/smoke/tinywave_smoke.sh (staging) -> outputs: latency_cold.txt, latency_warm.txt.
- Replay harness: use traffic-capture from 2028-01-27 (small-sessions) to replay at 1x and 5x.
- Manual prompt set to validate quality regressions (10 canonical prompts) — expect no semantic regressions.

Post-deploy validations (48–72h):
- Spot-check user-facing logs for increases in ambiguous completions (product has list of golden prompts).
- Check cost curves: token/unit cost delta by model-route. Flag if > 3% cost regression for cohort.
- E2E latencies for related routes (embeddings, reranking) to ensure no cross-impact.

Release notes (draft portion to be copied into public/internal release notes):
- Summary: Introduced Tinywave routing heuristics and KV cache warmup optimizations to reduce tail latency for short chat sessions. Initial rollout cohort: 3% on 2028-02-08.
- What changed:
  * New route selector that favors short-session micro-batching and local KV-cache priming.
  * Circuit-breaker added to gracefully fallback to previous routing when capacity is constrained.
  * Telemetry: new metrics tinywave.kv_hit_rate, tinywave.route_fallback_count.
- Impact: Improved p95 by ~8–12ms on lab tests for sessions <= 120 tokens. No expected breaking changes to API.
- Migration notes: None required. This is a serving/runtime optimization - customers using pinned model versions should not see behavior changes unless traffic was previously pinned to specialized variants.
- Known issues / caveats:
  1) Rare mismatch observed in staging when prefix-cache not warmed -> transient quality reduction in first token (tracked in RE-2743).
  2) If traffic spikes > 3x, fallback may trigger more frequently; this is intentional to preserve stability.

Open questions / items-to-triage (notes to self):
- Do we want to enable increased trace sampling for the entire cohort or keep it limited to 10% of requests? (Pros: debugging; Cons: cost).
- Need a short post-roll eval harness to validate semantic parity on larger prompt set (ask research to run 500 prompts overnight).
- Confirm whether we should update SDK docs about invisible routing change (probably not unless customers ask).

Post-mortem template (short):
- What happened: timeline of expansions, any detectable regressions, user impact.
- Root cause (if applicable): link to PR / logs.
- Corrective actions: improve KV-cache warmup, tune circuit-breaker thresholds, add more actionable alerting.
- Owners & deadlines: small set of owners (serving-runtime, infra, observability).

Todo (fast):
- [ ] Finalize canary-backoff thresholds and push to config repo (owner: Priya).
- [ ] Update #release-tinywave pinned message with rollback command examples (owner: Marcus).
- [ ] Kick off expanded eval job with research (owner: Ethan).

Notes / shorthand log (running):
- 2028-02-05 14:02 staging replay ran — saw p99 dip by 9ms under replay but a 7% KV hit drop on cold starts. Investigating warming scripts.
- 2028-02-07 11:15 stakeholder sync: legal asked if telemetry could leak model selection states -> confirm telemetry redaction.

End of draft — keep this doc as the single source for the tinywave operator checklist until we finalize.

-- Ava T.
